DRISYA P R

Senior Adobe Workfront Developer | Project Management & Workflow Automation +91-9946289214 | drisyapr@gmail.com | Coimbatore, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Senior Workfront Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, configuring, and optimizing Adobe Workfront solutions for enterprise environments. Proven expertise in Workfront Fusion automation, API integrations, custom reporting, and end-to-end platform implementations. Adobe Certified Expert with a strong track record of streamlining project management workflows, reducing manual operations, and aligning platform capabilities with complex business requirements.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Adobe Workfront Administration • Workfront Fusion (Automation) • API Integration & Development • Custom Forms & Workflow Configuration Dashboard & Reporting • Portfolio & Resource Management • Project Management • Data Migration & Environment Setup Requirements Gathering • Stakeholder Communication • Process Documentation • Technical Support • SQL • Java • JSP • Oracle DB

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer – Adobe Workfront | Wipro | Coimbatore, India May 2024 – Present

Led the design and implementation of Adobe Workfront solutions, aligning platform capabilities with enterprise project management and digital workflow needs.

Architected and delivered scalable workflow automations using Workfront Fusion, significantly reducing manual operations and improving process efficiency.

Customized and extended core Workfront components including Projects, Portfolios, custom forms, templates, and reporting frameworks to support complex business use cases.

Built advanced dashboards and custom reports enabling leadership to track KPIs, resource allocation, and project delivery in real time.

Led end-to-end implementation and migration initiatives including data transformations, environment setup, and production rollouts.

Workfront Developer | DLUX Tech | Coimbatore, India

Mar 2022 – May 2024 • Collaborated with Project Managers and customers on Workfront platform implementations and system

deployment.

Developed and maintained custom Workfront components: workflows, custom fields, layout templates, forms, resource/portfolio/program management, notifications, reports, and dashboards.

Designed and implemented data models and third-party integrations using Workfront Fusion. • Managed user profile administration and access control across the Workfront environment. • Drove ongoing rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives; maintained system documentation and best practices.

Executed proof-of-concept implementations to validate product feasibility and optimize the Workfront system for the Marketing department.

Software Developer | DoFort Technologies | Bangalore, India

Apr 2019 – Dec 2020

Developed daily business reports covering sales and manufacturing functions. • Implemented UI screens using Java and JSP; authored complex SQL queries for Oracle and SQL Server databases.

Gathered and interpreted requirements from functional stakeholders on the client side.

CERTIFICATIONS

Adobe Certified Expert – Adobe Workfront Core Developer • Adobe Certified Professional – Adobe Workfront Core Developer

Adobe Certified Professional – Adobe Workfront Project Manager • Adobe Certified Professional – Adobe Workfront Fusion

EDUCATION

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) Vidya Academy of Science and Technology, Calicut University 2015 – 2018

B.Sc. Computer Science – College of Applied Science, Calicut University (2012 – 2015)
